why: This is a study-specific validated measurement instrument, not a reusable instructional element; its intervention claims concern the life-education design rather than the questionnaire itself.
name: 56-item questionnaire measuring meaning of life, positive beliefs, and well-being
product_description: A 56-item, five-point Likert self-report questionnaire adapted from the Life Attitude Profile and Positive Coping, Spirituality and Well-Being Scale to measure nursing students’ meaning of life, positive beliefs, and well-being across pre-test, post-test, and four-week follow-up administrations.
